subject: MAP realignment request — evaluation window shift
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Tide MAP - potential evaluation slate shift

Team —

Quick note to flag a potential slip against Tide's MAP. We had a productive demo last week, but they just signaled a procurement hold while their security team finishes a contractual evidence review (SOC2 artifacts + network segmentation questions). Victoria from Tide is coordinating, but the ask I'm seeing is a 10–14 day push to the evaluation start.

Impacts:
- Evaluation kickoff would move from 6/12 -> ~6/26 (2-week delay).
- Risk to quarter: deal is in the mid-stage pipeline for Q2 recognition; delayed start increases probability of slip.
- Procurement outstanding: proof-of-concept env access, data retention answers, and updated SDDL requested.

Immediate asks:
1) Marissa — can you own a short MAP rebaseline doc (update milestones + dates) and share draft by EOD? Use the attached MAP v4 template.
2) Grace — can you coordinate a 1-page security artifact bundle we can publish to them? Focus: SOC2 section, KV rotation notes, and temporary access boundary.
3) Karthik — what options do we have for a minimal canary (reduced token quota/shorter TTL) to keep technical validation moving while procurement wraps?

I'll reply to the customer with a mitigations proposal (canary + narrow eval window) and a proposed revised timeline unless you tell me otherwise. If this slips beyond 14 days we should consider a formal escalation to Sales Ops for a concession.

Thanks —
Lukas
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Rossi <elena@tidesecurity.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@tidedev.com>
Date: 2028-06-04T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP and evaluation dates

Lukas —

Appreciate the demo last week. Quick update from our side: our legal and infosec team have flagged a few items that require evidence before the procurement director will clear the evaluation purchase order. The blockers are primarily: SOC2 detailed scope (we need the control list for the last 12 months), confirmation on KMS/HSM usage for keys, and a sample network ACL for private-link setup.

If possible, we need to shift the evaluation kickoff by ~2 weeks to allow our audit team time to review. We still plan to run the full evaluation — just need the extra time. We'll share the formal procurement note by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
VP, IT & Security
Tide Security

Attachment: procurement_cover_note.pdf (1 page, PDF)

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@tidesecurity.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@tidedev.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-04T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP and evaluation dates

Elena —

Totally understand and thank you for the clarity. Two proposals to keep momentum and reduce overall calendar risk:

Option A — Narrow canary (preferred):
- Start a 7-day canary pilot the week of 6/19 with a limited dataset and reduced token quota.
- Technical goals: validate latency and KV caching with your sample payloads.
- Security: canary runs in a segregated tenant, read-only sample data, access keys rotated on completion.

Option B — Rebaseline MAP:
- Move evaluation kickoff to 6/26, finish by 7/10 (two-week push).
- We'll deliver an updated MAP with new milestones and a compressed test plan.

We can also offer a short-term trial account with admin-only access for your security reviewers to inspect runtime logs and KMS usage (no production data). I'm attaching an updated MAP template (Tide_MAP_v4.xlsx) with both options and suggested dates. If you confirm which route you prefer, Marissa will update the MAP and Grace will assemble the security artifact bundle you requested.

If procurement requires it, we can include a written commitment to a fixed start date in DocuSign with a clause for a single 14-day extension.

Best,
Lukas
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Tide_MAP_v4.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-04T14:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP and evaluation dates — proposed escalation path

Thanks Lukas — copying here my suggested next steps. I'm pasting Elena's key line for context:

> "we need to shift the evaluation kickoff by ~2 weeks to allow our audit team time to review."

Proposed internal playbook:
1) Offer Option A (7-day canary) as a low-friction way to keep technical validation moving — ask Elena to sign a short acceptance email.
2) If Elena opts for Option B (full rebaseline), we update MAP v4 and propose a firm 6/26 start.
3) Escalation (if procurement pushes >21 days): request approval from Sales Ops for a conditional concession (one-time 10% credit on MRR for the first month) to keep deal velocity.

Marissa action items: I will prepare the revised MAP draft (Timeline + acceptance lines) and a one-page concession rationale for Sales Ops review. Target: draft MAP by 6/04 EOD, concession note 6/05 AM.

Karthik — if Option A is acceptable, can you outline minimal resource footprint (GPU hours, token cap) so we can include an SOW-lite clause?

Grace — once I have sign-off, send Elena the security artifact bundle.

—Marissa
Account Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-06T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Escalation summary: Tide deal — MAP realignment and concession ask

Neha —

Summary and request for quick approval. Thread attached below. Key facts:
- Customer: Tide Security (Elena Rossi)
- Original MAP kickoff: 2028-06-12
- Customer asks: ~14-day delay for procurement/security review (SOC2 artifacts, KMS confirmation, ACL sample)
- Recommended mitigation: Offer Option A (7-day canary week of 6/19) to keep technical validation, plus Option B (rebaseline to 6/26) as fallback.
- Concession ask (only if procurement requires >21-day slip): one-time 10% credit on first month MRR or equivalent service credit.

Why approval needed: concession falls outside standard delegated discount authority and will impact Q2 recognition if the deal slips beyond the quarter. Approve the one-time credit? If yes, Marissa will include the concession in a conditional DocuSign addendum; Karthik will add SOW-lite terms for the canary.

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890 — HubSpot deal D-2028-0921
DocuSign (conditional addendum): https://app.docusign.com/agreements/5A3F2B
MAP draft attachment: Tide_MAP_v4.xlsx
Procurement timeline: Procurement_Timeline.pdf

Thanks for a quick read — if you approve, reply-all with a one-line authorization and we will proceed to execute.

Lukas
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
